titleZh: 我的心，你要稱頌耶和華
titleEn: Bless the Lord, My Soul, Praise His Holy Name
composer: 林良真 Tracie Lin, 游智婷 Sandy Yu

background.zh: 收錄於讚美之泉敬拜讚美專輯《甦醒 Awakening》，經文摘編：林良真（Tracie Lin），作曲：林良真、游智婷（Sandy Yu），英文翻譯：Violet Chen，此版本由 InOne Music Ministries 合一音樂事工演唱。歌詞版權屬讚美之泉音樂事工所有，請依教會相關授權規範使用。
background.en: From Stream of Praise's worship album "Awakening," with words drawn from Psalm 103 by Tracie Lin, music by Tracie Lin and Sandy Yu, and English translation by Violet Chen; this recording is performed by InOne Music Ministries. © Stream of Praise Music — please use under the appropriate licensing for your church.

zh: 我的心 你要稱頌耶和華
祂赦免你一切過犯罪孽
en: Bless the Lord, my soul, praise His holy name
Forget none of all His grace
He forgave your sin and He healed your pain
And cured you of all illness

zh: 我的心 你要稱頌耶和華
祂以仁愛慈悲為你冠冕
en: Bless the Lord, my soul, praise His holy name
Forget none of all His grace
He redeemed your life and defended you
And crowned you with mercy and love

zh: 祂使我的過犯也離我多遠
en: As high as the heaven above
His love is with those who fear Him
As far as the east is from west
So far has he taken our sins away
As a father is kind to his sons
So the Lord has compassion on us
Everlasting to everlasting
Lord Jehovah He is my God
